title: Windows host: sync/team test cluster fails on a stock setup
observation:
STILL OPEN, but the 2026-08-11 claim that it reproduces in the working repo did NOT hold on 2026-08-12. A full `npm test` (--test-concurrency=2, the exact config the reopen note said reproduces it) ran green on this Windows host: 1080 tests, 1073 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped, exit 0, ~19.5 min. So either the cluster is flaky rather than deterministic, or something between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-12 changed it.

A plausible mechanism now exists for at least part of it: this host carried an UNCOMMITTED local core.autocrlf=false while the system value is true, and .gitattributes had no text directive — so the working repo and a fresh clone did not see the same bytes. 3cb75af makes LF canonical (`* text=auto eol=lf` + renormalize of 13 CRLF-committed files), which removes that divergence. That is a HYPOTHESIS, not a measurement: the clean-clone case has NOT been re-run since 3cb75af, and doing so is the next step. Do not file this resolved on the working-repo run alone — this finding was already wrongly filed resolved once on exactly that kind of evidence.
